canon.bentley: a chocolate-and-tan long-haired dachshund with a liver-brown nose, warm amber eyes, tan eyebrow pips and tan muzzle, silky feathered chocolate ears and plumed tail
canon.watson: an English-cream long-haired dachshund with a glossy black nose, dark soulful eyes, honey-cream coat shading darker along the ears and spine, heavy silky feathering and plumed tail
canon.both_dogs: two long-haired dachshunds of the same height standing together, one chocolate-and-tan with a liver-brown nose and warm amber eyes, one English-cream with a glossy black nose and dark eyes

default_motion: Gentle natural movement. Soft warm light. No camera shake, no fast motion.

_notes.render_mode: reference = beats whose image_prompt carries a {token} found in reference_map render via the fal /edit endpoint, conditioned on those refs. Token-free beats fall through to text-to-image AND have the people-directive stripped (Rule 1: person-free by definition).
_notes.canon: Every {token} used in any VISUAL must have a canon entry — _expand_canon raises SystemExit on unknown tags. Tokens do double duty: attach the reference image AND expand into the prompt text.
_notes.timing_source: beatsheet = no narration-timed audio leg. Timing declared per beat; VO is a sparse removable layer. See wordless-vo-wiring-spec.md.
_notes.default_beat_hold: Deliberate v1 baseline. Flat pacing is a diagnostic, not a target. Tune at the stills gate once the channel has traction.
_notes.size_word: No size adjective in the canon on purpose — 'miniature' was a canon error. The reference images carry the correct medium build.
